input.description: A `Tensor`. Can be of any rank.
constraints: The output tensor's i'th dimension has `params.input.dims(i) * params.multiples[i]` elements, dimension. For example, tiling a tensor by a 1-D tensor produces a tensor with the specified shape and dtype.

multiples.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. 1-D. Length must be the same as the number of dimensions in `input`
constraints: Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`.
Length must be the same as the number of dimensions in input
multiples must be one of int32, int64

The output tensor's i'th dimension has `params.input.dims(i) * params.multiples[i]` elements, dimension. For example, tiling a tensor by a 1-D tensor produces a tensor with the specified shape and dtype.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`.
